items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: The interviewee mentions Dick Mackey left the band, discusses his career with Harold Kemp, and mentions knowing his sons, but does not describe a direct professional or personal relationship with Dick Mackey himself.

ctx.x: Okay. We'll see here somewhere now.
What are you looking for, Dick?
I just dropped a reel. There it is. Right here. Yeah.
